previous_outcomes_seen: First frozen Hoeffding panel results and strong alternative certification of 0%,13.17%,81.5%,97.17% by m 50/200/1000/5000 were seen before choosing exact CP; this is a prospective successor not blind independent validation.
calibration_model: Four external independent Binomial(n,q) known-passage reference samples per season×predeclared-solar-bin, entirely independent of the animal detections
exact_CP_intervals: For each of four binomial counts S in n trials, CP two-sided confidence 1-alpha_joint/4=0.99375. Lower q solves P_q(Bin(n,q)>=S)=alpha_joint/8 for S>0, else 0; upper solves P_q(Bin(n,q)<=S)=alpha_joint/8 for S<n, else 1. Bonferroni gives four-cell simultaneous coverage >=0.975.
opponent: Previously frozen parent symmetric Hoeffding intervals with eps=sqrt(log(8/alpha_joint)/(2*n)) and same 0.975 four-cell guarantee.
exact_numerics: Use log-combination from lgamma, stable normalized full Binomial PMF with logsumexp on n+1 states, bisection of lower/upper tails for 52 iterations, support n<=5000, fail closed if final tail residual >5e-8.
calibration_scenarios: Use only fixed previous four true q vectors and previous artificial count tables at trial counts n=50,200,1000,5000; deterministic representatively rounded successes round(n*q) in each cell, NOT randomly observed data or an empirical coverage experiment.
detector_upper_bound: q_falling_early_upper*q_rising_late_upper/(q_rising_early_lower*q_falling_late_lower), infinity and status HOLD if denominator q lower<=0
animal_decision: Same parent exact conditional one-sided noncentral Fisher robust test at theta_effort*B, alpha_test=.025; no new main count table or fitted animal effect
reporting: all four synthetic q worlds × four reference trial levels for both band methods
CP vs Hoeffding upper detector OR B and resulting robust p for the same fixed synthetic animal count table
CP vs Hoeffding exact one-sided 97.5% lower latent encounter OR for the same table
first reference-per-cell level in predeclared grid supporting the strong-effect synthetic table for both methods, report none if absent

no statistical power or average calibration cost claim based only on rounded reference successes
first parent q calibration simulation remains terminal; no tuning it after first outcome
hard_gates: all q bounds in [0,1] and true point q inside both for these representative rounded counts (diagnostic only)
CP cellwise Clopper-Pearson one-sided tail equations numerically verified for interior S
four CP intervals simultaneous coverage >=0.975 by Bonferroni; animal test alpha=0.025; combined <=0.05, with reference independent from wildlife observations
no favorable calibration count selection or cherry-picked site or astronomical date
same parent observed synthetic animal counts, same exposure OR, same solar bins
